title: Dragon NFX2 Ski Goggles with Bonus Lens

comparisons.notes: Variant Blizzard / Lumalens Midnight + Light Rose bonus lens, barcode 886895549448; in stock.
Variant Vantas / Lumalens Midnight + Lumalens Violet bonus lens, UPC 886895729123; in stock.

writeup: Dragon's NFX2 frameless goggles with a bonus low-light Lumalens are new on Woot for $44.99 in Vantas, Blizzard and Fasani 25 colorways. Gear West sells the same Blizzard set for $129.33 and Ski & Tennis Station asks $161 for Vantas. Swiftlock makes lens swaps quick, and Woot shows only about one left per color, limit 3.
amazon_match_notes: Verified checker matched the Blizzard NFX2 bonus-lens colorway by UPC.
